title: Enquanto o bot caça, a família
concept: Golden-hour vlog with warm bokeh and no shakes: 'ENQUANTO O BOT CAÇA…' is completed by the real customer photo of family handprints at 15:37 ('eu me divertido com a família', verbatim), then 16:24 chat lines from a different customer away from home ('Tô longe de casa cm a família / O bot já tá rodando e liso'), the phone-access claim, and the peak line 'O tempo é seu. O farm é dele.'

notes: Concept's family-handprints.png = family-handprints (photo + caption shown together as in the original; quote verbatim with the typo 'divertido'); aproveitando-com-a-familia = away-with-family (different customer → 'prints reais de clientes diferentes'). 'Aqui tô pelo Cell' was dropped: its print (--phone) also names the customer's city and is a complaint about lag on the phone, so only the --quote lines are used ('Tô longe de casa cm a família' / 'O bot já tá rodando e liso'). The phone-access claim is shown as a brand illustration (phone with the robot) + chips 'acesso pelo celular' / '100% AFK'. Gentle motion only, no shakes (as briefed). Added a 'KizuBot rodando' chip in the hook as the early brand cue. Rubric: hook 8, re-hooks 8, clarity 8, craft 8, truth 9, sound 8, brand 8, CTA 9, loop 8, distinct 9 (avg 8.3). 1 render.
